resources.string: Choose how much you need, for how many days and in how many payments. Lenders will see your request and your reputation.
You do everything in LatiFi through a wallet: a free app on your phone that holds your digital money and asks you to approve each action. You will connect one at the end.
Browse open requests. Each one shows the borrower\'s reputation, the rate and the term, so you decide before you lend.
You see the total to repay before you accept. Pay each installment on its date, from your own wallet.
Each installment paid on time raises your reputation. A higher reputation helps lenders trust your next request.
LatiFi never holds your money or the secret code that unlocks your wallet. You approve every action in your own wallet.
